comment: Liz is a very nice professor who is fairly easy. There is very little work for the class and as long as you skim the readings, you can certainly do well. The class itself was a little dull at times because she rambles off topic for long period of time. She really wants you to do well and will help you any way she can.

Liz is a character. She is funny, energetic, and spontaneous. The class was fun at times, but sometimes it was boring. She did her best never to offend anyone because it was a culture class. I really appreciate this effort. She is a good teacher and always has stories that keep you interested. && She brings in oreos!!
